note: The OLG covers earned income verification requirements (Types of Earned Income > Verification of Income), investigation of questionable/contradictory information (Unclear Information page, What is Questionable and Contradictory Information? page), and extensive external agency data matching procedures via the PI Checklist (DOR Wage, DOR New Hire, Work Number, DUA matches). These collectively implement the federal IEVS requirements through Massachusetts-specific systems. However, three specific FNS elements are not explicitly covered: (1) The FNS requirement to run IEVS checks specifically for 'all adult household members and household members under 18 not enrolled in school' — the OLG's PI Checklist applies broadly but does not state this population-scoping rule; (2) The FNS 3-quarter lookback rule (when IEVS shows employment within the three most recent quarters prior to the sample month, the reviewer must contact the household and listed employers) has no direct OLG equivalent — match processing procedures exist but lack this specific temporal trigger; (3) The explicit 'No Further Investigation' / 'Further Investigation' conditional decision tree from FNS is not mirrored in the OLG, though the PI Checklist match disposition workflow provides functionally similar guidance. The OLG's coverage is operationally robust through BEACON-integrated match processing, but does not document the underlying federal verification framework that these systems implement.
